approval_scope: Approximate visual direction; not permission to send a test post or enable autopublishing.
typography: large bold light text; restrained lime highlights
presenter: Recognizable Lester from existing channel avatar, usually a shoulder-up portrait with direct gaze.
composition: Clear headline, relevant art or real media, at most two or three main information groups; vary placement for each story.
dates: When multiple dates matter, label each separately and include the year where needed.
branding: GTA6 Досье Лестера; @lesterdossier; subtle dossier number optional.
media_policy: Real frames/screenshots for evidence; generated imagery is an authored illustration, never evidence.
avoid: source credits, source URLs or channel watermarks
